# garak(1) — exemplar reference page

> **garak** — Generative AI Red-teaming & Assessment Kit (LLM
> vulnerability scanner)

| | |
|---|---|
| Layer | ATTACK |
| Category | A-2 — LLM Prompt Injection & Jailbreaking |
| Safety class | **requires-target** (refuses to run bare) |
| Licence | Apache-2.0 |
| Upstream | [github.com/NVIDIA/garak](https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak) |

## NAME

`garak` — probes LLMs and dialog systems for hallucination, data
leakage, prompt injection, misinformation, toxicity generation and
jailbreaks: probes, detectors and buffs against a target model.

## SYNOPSIS

```
garak --target_type TYPE --target_name NAME [-S SPEC] [OPTIONS]
garak --list_probes [-v] [--spec SPEC]
garak --plugin_info TYPE.PLUGIN.CLASS
garak --version
```

## DESCRIPTION

`garak` scans a target model with static, dynamic and adaptive
**probes**, scores outputs with **detectors**, and modifies probe
behaviour with **buffs**. All runs require a target generator —
consistent with its `requires-target` safety class; the tool does
not self-fire.

## EXAMPLES

```
garak --target_type ollama --target_name llama3.2:latest --spec tag:owasp:llm01
garak --target_type openai --target_name gpt-4o-mini --spec probes.dan
garak --list_probes -v
```
